title: Developing trustworthy AI applications with foundation models
findings: The paper highlights that foundation models can exhibit significant religious bias, citing 'persistent anti-muslim bias in large language models' like GPT-3 as a specific risk in the 'Fairness' dimension of trustworthiness that must be addressed when developing AI applications.
